text:
Main samajhta hoon aapki pareshani, aur iske liye maafi chahta hoon. Main aapko poori baat clearly batata hoon.

Aapke order ORD-22004 par maine **₹19,999 ka full refund** initiate kar diya hai jo 3-5 din mein aapke account mein aa jayega. 

Jahan tak delivery aur theft/misdelivery complaint ki baat hai, system mein delivery "delivered" dikha raha hai, aur maine is missing package ka case hamare logistics department ko investigation ke liye forward kar diya hai. 

Kya aap chahte hain ki main aapko ek human customer care agent se connect karoon taaki aap unse is investigation ke baare mein aur detail mein baat kar sakein?
